C9000315.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 315 (The four-dimensional Singer conjecture.; papers: The Singer conjecture in dimension four; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

M_SINGER_MAIN.statement: For a finite connected aspherical integral Poincare four-complex with arbitrary orientation character, all L2 Betti numbers outside degree two vanish.

M_OTHER_STEPS.statement: The boundary construction, no-cut-point block reduction, path pushing, and remaining Singer proof obligations outside this mission are valid.

L_PRET_INVARIANT_CLASS.statement: Under the hypotheses of pret:invariant-class, Gamma preserves a finite-interval class in the original completed pretree.

L_PRET_PACKAGE.statement: The complete median flow completion, compact supports, quotient completeness, and fixed-point package are available under the manuscript's hypotheses.

L_PRET_PARABOLIC_CUTS.statement: The final dendritic quotient is a point and each global cut point is parabolic under the stated splitting obstruction.

L_PRET_PARABOLIC_STAR.statement: A parabolic fixing a cut point fixes only that point and adjacent completion points; an infinite-order element fixing an infinite interval has terminal fixed endpoints.

L_PRET_ENDPOINT.statement: In any complete median pretree, if nonempty full U is invariant under an automorphism fixing p in a disjoint full V, that automorphism fixes a point outside V; neither fiber needs to be complete.

L_PRET_FINITE_TREE.statement: A finitely generated one-ended group acting without inversions on a simplicial tree with finite edge stabilizers fixes a vertex.

C_APR_CRITERION.statement: For a finitely generated one-ended group with no infinite torsion subgroup acting minimally by convergence on a nondegenerate compact metric continuum with nonempty invariant cut set P, D_P(B) is a point if and only if an original finite-interval class is invariant.
C_APR_CRITERION.note: The Engineer supplied a full proof and a formally verified infinite core. Independent source, fidelity, novelty and significance review remain pending; this is not campaign-final acceptance.

C_APR_ROOT_TRANSLATION.statement: Rooting a complete median pretree at p gives a semilinear meet-semilattice with suprema for every monotone natural-number sequence; full fibers translate to the meet-closed and lower sets in the formal endpoint theorem.

C_APR_FORMAL_CORE.statement: The arbitrary-type second-fixed-point order theorem, terminal facing-class singleton theorem, and finite-generation limit-stage theorem hold with the exact hypotheses documented in statement_fidelity.md.
